title: Un kilo, por favor
summary: Market vocabulary — quantities, ¿me pone…?, and ¿algo más?

blocks.title: At the mercado
blocks.body: Markets sell by weight and count. **un kilo** (a kilo), **medio kilo** (half a kilo), **un cuarto** (a quarter kilo), **una docena** (a dozen), **un poco de...** (a little of...) — the basic quantities you'll need at any stall.

blocks.title: ¿Me pone...? — asking at the counter
blocks.body: **¿Me pone...?** (literally 'will you put me...?') is the classic, polite way to ask for something at a market stall or counter — softer than *quiero*. The stallholder will often follow up with **¿algo más?** ('anything else?'); if you're done, answer **nada más, gracias**.
blocks.callout: *¿Me pone un kilo de tomates?* — a question, not a demand. Very Spanish, very polite.

blocks.prompt: You've got everything you need at the market stall. How do you answer '¿algo más?'
blocks.explain: *Nada más, gracias* — 'nothing else, thanks' — closes the order politely.
